meta.description: Symbolic proof scaffold for continuation requiring non-empty admissible image.

proof_scaffold.target_statement: A continuation_event exists only if the admissible image of the continuation candidate set under Pi_A and delta selection is non-empty.

conditions.statement: The participation_space contains at least one non-null locus under the declared epsilon_null rule.
Pi_A maps at least one candidate continuation into the admissibility_window.
delta has at least one admissible candidate after selection and branch-pruning constraints are applied.
No residue/orientation condition eliminates all candidate continuations.

symbolic_steps.description: Establish initial candidate set for continuation.

symbolic_steps.expression: C_A = { c in C | Pi_A(c) == c }
symbolic_steps.description: Filter candidates into admissibility window. If C_A is empty, no continuation possible (NEI-003).
Apply selection and pruning rules. If C_S is empty, continuation fails (NEI-004).
The resulting event must be a member of the non-empty admissible selected set.
